The <b>{{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is used at the embalming table to add two {{Skull|red}}. Dark injection are used to even out the number of {{Skull|red}}for use with the [[Gold injection]], although transplanting an actual dark organ or removing a skull is still a cheaper alternative,
